# Comments

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Manage comments on Jira issues. Comments support plain text and Atlassian
Document Format (ADF). Visibility can be restricted to a specific role or group.

## jira comment add

Add a comment to an issue.

**Aliases:** `jira issue comment add`

### Usage

```
jira comment add <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--body` | `-b` | Comment body (plain text or ADF JSON) |
| `--visibility` | | Restrict visibility: `role:Developer`, `group:jira-software-users`, etc. |
| `--internal` | | Mark as internal (Service Management only) |
| `--web` | `-w` | Open the issue in browser after commenting |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
# Add a plain text comment
jira comment add MYPROJ-42 -b "Fixed in v1.2.0, will deploy Monday"

# Add with restricted visibility
jira comment add MYPROJ-42 -b "Internal note" --visibility "role:Service Desk Team"

# Read comment body from stdin
echo "Automated comment from CI" | jira comment add MYPROJ-42

# Add and open issue in browser
jira comment add MYPROJ-42 -b "Done!" --web
```

## jira comment list

List comments on an issue.

**Aliases:** `jira issue comment list`, `ls`

### Usage

```
jira comment list <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum comments to display (default 25) |
| `--order` | | Order: `asc` or `desc` (default `asc`) |

### Examples

```bash
jira comment list MYPROJ-42
jira comment list MYPROJ-42 --limit 10 --order desc
jira comment list MYPROJ-42 --json
```

---

## jira comment edit

Edit an existing comment.

**Alias:** `jira issue comment edit`

### Usage

```
jira comment edit <issue-key> <comment-id> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--body` | `-b` | New comment body |
| `--visibility` | | Update visibility restriction |

### Examples

```bash
jira comment edit MYPROJ-42 10002 -b "Updated: deployed on Monday"
```

---

## jira comment delete

Delete a comment from an issue.

**Alias:** `jira issue comment delete`

### Usage

```
jira comment delete <issue-key> <comment-id> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | | Skip confirmation prompt |

### Examples

```bash
jira comment delete MYPROJ-42 10002
jira comment delete MYPROJ-42 10002 --confirm
```
